conceptZh: 扭蛋小怪獸衝過頭，滾過頭頂的草叢又煞車折回，輕輕一踩，草葉長成「艹」，下面的太陽變成「早」，湊成「草」。
object: a round fuzzy pocket creature, a patch of springy green grass blades and a yellow toy sun
morph: grass blades sprout into the top 艹 and a little sun settles as 早 below, forming 草
creativeAngle: 衝過頭：小怪獸衝過草地滑出畫面再折回，第二次輕輕一碰，草葉才長成「艹」，下面的小太陽落成「早」。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and fresh, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-cream backdrop with a pale blue-white floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated grass-green Traditional Chinese glyph 草, the grass crown 艹 on top of the 早 component, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original round fuzzy sky-blue pocket creature with big eyes and stubby feet that bursts out of a gachapon capsule and bounces off everything; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the capsule rolls in from the left and pops open, and the creature shoots out like a rocket across the floor at far too much speed; the first spoken 草 lands as it skids right through a patch of green grass blades, the blades whipping flat in its wake, and slides off the right edge of the frame. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): a faint bounce-bounce sound, and the creature comes sproinging back from the right edge, overshoots the other way, rolls over and over with grass stuck all over its fur, and stops dizzy in the middle with a blade stuck on its head; the second spoken 草 lands as it flops flat. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): the creature slowly gets up, tiptoes forward and taps the ground with one gentle foot; the grass blades spring up and form two neat green tufts joined into the 艹 crown at the top, a little yellow toy sun with a sleepy face rises and settles below as 早, and the word 草莓 is spoken as a tiny red strawberry with a green hat pops out of the grass at the creature's feet and wobbles. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 草 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in green; the creature sits at the side, nibbling a blade like a toothpick and rocking with a happy wobble, the little strawberry giggling beside it, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「草、草、草莓」, read as ㄘㄠˇ、ㄘㄠˇ、ㄘㄠˇ ㄇㄟˊ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.9s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. No background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
